svg.aria-label: Plate IV, excavation. Surface: CivilizationOS, 10 agents and 5 councils, live; Recall, recall at 1 of 10 out of 10 at 149 ms median; autocto, 5 analyzers and 162 tests on PyPI; AFTERSHOCK, ROC AUC 0.817 on 829 held-out breakouts; Agent Factory, 6 agents on frozen contracts. Below ground the personal-llm kernel with 181 offline tests, reached by second-brain with 116 tests, github-pr-agent with 84, and DreamOS.

svg.text: One memory kernel, sunk once and reached by every app below ground. The headframes above are the systems people can use.
below ground: imports the kernel instead of rebuilding retrieval
